# Draft Letter: Heater Repair Request

Subject: Request for Prompt Repair of Broken Heater

Dear [Landlord’s Name],

I hope you are well. I am writing to request repair of the heater in my apartment, which has been broken since **2025-12-15**.

I first reported this issue by email on **2025-12-16**, and I followed up again on **2025-12-23**. As of today, I have not received a response, and the heater remains unrepaired.

I moved into the apartment on **2025-09-01**, and I am asking that this issue be addressed promptly. Please arrange for the heater to be repaired within **7 days** of receiving this letter. If you need access to the unit to complete the repair, please let me know a convenient time.

Thank you for your attention to this matter. I appreciate your prompt response and look forward to a quick resolution.

Sincerely,
[Your Full Name]
[Apartment Number]
[Phone Number]
[Email Address]
